amman.regulator: WAJ, Water Authority of Jordan / Miyahuna
amman.water: One of the most water-scarce countries in the world, leak-free welded joints are active water conservation (Non-Revenue Water < 2%).
amman.note: Development bank funded projects: K-Aqua provides tender-compliant documentation.
amman.extendedMarketText: The urban infrastructure in this region poses special requirements for the longevity and reliability of piping systems. With extreme climatic conditions and stringent water hygiene standards, K-Aqua's PP-R and PPRCT solutions offer a decisive advantage. Traditional metallic pipes often suffer from corrosion and mineral deposits, leading to significant pressure drops and water waste through leakages. Conversely, K-Aqua systems guarantee an absolutely leak-proof, maintenance-free installation for over 50 years, thanks to their corrosion-free material composition and homogeneous polyfusion welding. Furthermore, the smooth inner surface enables optimal hydraulic flow characteristics, which drastically reduces the energy demand for circulation pumps. These factors make K-Aqua the preferred choice for large-scale hotel complexes, hospitals, industrial cooling systems, and demanding residential construction projects in the urban sector.
